title: Turkish-Style Beef Doner Kebab
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring thinly sliced beef, served in a warm pita with crunchy vegetables and creamy sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, beef broth, and a pinch of salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
2. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Preheat a vertical spit or a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove the meat from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
5. Thread the meat onto the spit or skewers, if using.
6. Cook the meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
7. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
8. Slice the meat into thin strips against the grain.
9. Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5-7 minutes.
10. Assemble the kebabs by placing a few slices of meat onto each pita, followed by a dollop of mayonnaise, a sprinkle of salad dressing, and a layer of sliced vegetables.
